findings.text: The newly added save guard checks each text box only against the canvas; it never checks pairs of text boxes or labels against plotted data, so figure.savefig at line 471 still accepts those collisions despite the mandatory mechanical figure-save requirement; add those checks and demonstrate their refusal with colliding text before accepting this node.
